questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this code authenticates session tokens? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
Why does verify compare lengths before calling timingSafeEqual?
choices: To make the comparison faster for valid tokens
Because timingSafeEqual throws when the buffers differ in length
Because base64url signatures can have variable padding
To reject tokens signed with a different algorithm

questions.prompt: A request carries a correctly signed token whose exp passed one minute ago. What does the client receive?
A payroll admin is demoted to employee in the database. When does their access change?
choices: Immediately, because requireRole reads the role from the database
On the next request, because verify re-signs the token
When their current token expires, within at most 15 minutes
